notes: Yolo (YOLO) is an ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the entire fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the launch factory. It has no administrative powers, transfer fees, or external mint or burn functions. No application contracts are deployed. The opening pool price is derived from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply; pool.initialPrice is provenance only.
